offline_definition: expanding mean of confirmed-fraud labels strictly before transaction timestamp (unbounded window)

ibm_static_dataset.nature: pre-labeled synthetic dataset with Is Fraud? column
ibm_static_dataset.production_relevance: static file; labels are properties of the dataset, NOT produced by a live confirmation pipeline before decisions
ibm_static_dataset.verdict: RETROSPECTIVE only — does not constitute production label availability at decision time

verification_outcome.mechanism: Investigator confirms/disputes alerts → VerificationOutcome(score_id, outcome='confirmed'/'disputed', case_id)
verification_outcome.timing: AFTER the alert is generated and investigator reviews — retrospective, not decision-time
verification_outcome.consumed_by: scripts/export_feedback.py → retraining pool; NOT fed to EntityFraudRateTracker before new decisions

risk_engine_entity_tracker.timing: Called via background_task AFTER each evaluation — uses model's own score as the label
risk_engine_entity_tracker.verdict: FORBIDDEN — model predictions must not be used as confirmed fraud labels per Phase 10C §3

entity_tracker_seeding.timing: Called at startup from DB-2 history — uses risk_score threshold, not confirmed labels

in_repo_label_pipeline_at_decision_time: NONE — no pipeline exists that feeds confirmed fraud labels to the risk engine before a new transaction is evaluated
evidence_summary: The project has NO mechanism to receive a confirmed fraud label for an entity's history before evaluating a new transaction. VerificationOutcome labels arrive after investigation (retrospective). The risk engine uses score>=70 as a proxy (forbidden). The IBM dataset labels exist statically but are not a live stream.
verdict: The three fraud-rate features CANNOT be produced with legitimate confirmed labels at decision time. They must be removed from the production model. This triggers PATH B (new production-native candidate required).
